comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 flags any comment citing external evidence (data, statistics, studies, sources, documented facts or cases) in support of its counter-argument. Item 1 flags only a concrete real-world analogy, meaning a specific case used as a comparison to the issue. Item 0 would count statistics or a study with no comparison. Item 1 would count an everyday analogy that is not cited evidence. The two overlap only partially, and neither is a subtype with the same eligibility rules. Source column, dtype and null/empty handling match, but the core predicates differ.
